text:
maya (CEO): huge thanks to everyone who joined today — quick follow-up thread for notes, clarifications, and owners. i'll drop the recording + slides below.

sam (product): recording: https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/abcd-efgh. slides: https://drive.redwood.co/allhands-apr-2026.pdf

jordan (eng): question — the Dedicated autoscaling change: is that a breaking config change for current Dedicated customers?

sam (product): not breaking. customers can keep current config. default autoscale behavior will be opt-in for the next 30 days, then opt-out window for 90 days. we'll post migration docs.

eva (devex): action: write migration doc + sample helm values. owner: @jordan. ETA: 2026-04-12.

jordan (eng): ack. i'll drop a PR with examples. quick snippet i'll include:```yaml
# sample autoscale config
autoscale:
  enabled: true
  target_rps: 250
  burst_capacity: 2
```

kai (sales): a couple of enterprise customers asked about SLA dates for Private deployments — what's the timeline?

maya (CEO): Private GA target: end of Q3 2026. initial private installs (pilot) starting mid-June. sales, expect a pilot program doc next week.

sam (product): clarifying note re: API compatibility — hosted API stays v1; no changed endpoints. model routing policy additions (new query params) will be additive only.

eva (devex): i'll update the Quickstart repo and examples to show routing params, assigned to me. ETA: 2026-04-09.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra:canary -> canary-1 on 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z (noted by @ops).

jordan (eng): small follow-up: is there a public benchmark matrix promised in the roadmap? i remember a slide but not the link.

maya (CEO): yes — we'll publish an initial benchmark suite next month (latency/cost by model + quantization). owner: @sam. expected publish: 2026-05-15.

kai (sales): can we get a short blurb for customers about the benchmark goals? i'll include in outreach.

sam (product): will prepare a 3-bullet blurb and share here by EOD Friday.

maya (CEO): owners summary: @jordan -> autoscale migration doc + helm examples (ETA 4/12), @eva -> quickstart + routing examples (ETA 4/9), @sam -> benchmark pub + customer blurb (ETA 5/15, blurb by Fri). please react with :thumbsup: when you're good with the ETA.

jordan (eng): :thumbsup:

eva (devex): :thumbsup:

sam (product): :thumbsup:

kai (sales): tagging customers list to prepare comms.

maya (CEO): i'll follow up with the leadership thread on any budget asks related to Private pilots. thanks all.

notes: keep follow-up Qs in this thread so we can keep owners visible.
